summary.en: A highly legible variable sans designed for screens and dense interfaces.
summary.zh: 專為螢幕與資訊密集介面設計、閱讀性很高的可變無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Product interfaces, dashboards, and dependable body copy.
bestFor.zh: 產品介面、儀表板，以及穩定耐讀的內文字體。

summary.en: An open-source sans with a broad family and calm, readable texture.
summary.zh: 字重完整、字面平穩耐讀的開源無襯線字體家族。

bestFor.en: Long-form reading, documentation, and restrained product UI.
bestFor.zh: 長文閱讀、文件網站與風格克制的產品介面。

summary.en: A neutral global type family built for consistent multilingual coverage.
summary.zh: 為多語系一致性而打造、中性且涵蓋廣泛的全球字體家族。

bestFor.en: International products and systems that need broad script support.
bestFor.zh: 需要支援多種文字系統的國際化產品與設計系統。

summary.en: A versatile global serif with a composed reading rhythm across scripts.
summary.zh: 跨文字系統仍維持沉穩閱讀節奏的多用途全球襯線字體。

bestFor.zh: 多語系編輯版面、報告與長篇內文。

summary.en: A precise sans that balances technical structure with a human voice.
summary.zh: 兼具技術結構與人味、細節精準的無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Technical products, data-heavy pages, and brand systems.
bestFor.zh: 技術產品、資料密集頁面與品牌設計系統。

summary.en: A readable monospaced companion with distinctive but controlled details.
summary.zh: 辨識度明確但不搶戲、適合閱讀的等寬字體。

bestFor.en: Code, technical metadata, tables, and numeric labels.
bestFor.zh: 程式碼、技術中繼資料、表格與數字標籤。

summary.en: A modern geometric sans with open forms and a friendly, polished tone.
summary.zh: 字腔開放、氣質友善俐落的現代幾何無襯線字體。

bestFor.zh: 現代 SaaS 品牌、登陸頁與介面標題。

summary.en: A practical sans with warm details that scales from interface text to display.
summary.zh: 帶有溫度、能從介面小字延伸到展示標題的實用無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Friendly digital products and editorial websites.
bestFor.zh: 親切的數位產品與編輯型網站。

summary.en: A low-contrast geometric sans tuned for clean digital communication.
summary.zh: 低對比、適合清楚數位溝通的幾何無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Marketing sites, lightweight product UI, and compact headings.
bestFor.zh: 行銷網站、輕量產品介面與精簡標題。

summary.en: A contemporary serif with calligraphic roots and an approachable reading texture.
summary.zh: 帶有書寫根源、閱讀質地親切的當代襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Essays, storytelling, and editorial brands that need warmth.
bestFor.zh: 散文、故事內容，以及需要溫度的編輯品牌。

summary.en: A sturdy screen serif with generous forms and clear hierarchy.
summary.zh: 字形寬裕、層次清楚，專為螢幕閱讀打造的穩健襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Long articles, knowledge bases, and text-forward sites.
bestFor.zh: 長篇文章、知識庫與文字為主的網站。

summary.en: A broad, confident grotesque family with strong editorial range.
summary.zh: 字族完整、語氣自信，具有編輯彈性的 Grotesque 無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Editorial systems, cultural institutions, and expressive UI.
bestFor.zh: 編輯系統、文化機構與具表情的介面。

summary.en: A high-contrast transitional serif that brings immediate editorial drama.
summary.zh: 高對比的過渡型襯線字體，能迅速建立編輯感與戲劇張力。

bestFor.en: Large headlines, luxury positioning, and editorial moments.
bestFor.zh: 大型標題、精品定位與需要編輯張力的段落。

summary.en: A digital Bodoni revival with sharp contrast and fashion-led elegance.
summary.zh: 對比銳利、帶有時尚優雅氣質的數位 Bodoni 復刻。

bestFor.en: Fashion, arts, hospitality, and short premium headlines.
bestFor.zh: 時尚、藝術、旅宿品牌與精簡的高質感標題。

summary.en: An expressive Garamond-inspired family with delicate, classical proportions.
summary.zh: 比例細緻、富有表情的 Garamond 風格古典襯線字體家族。

bestFor.en: Arts, literature, invitations, and elegant display settings.
bestFor.zh: 藝術、文學、邀請函與優雅的展示排版。

summary.en: A variable display serif with soft curves, wit, and adjustable character.
summary.zh: 曲線柔和、富有趣味，能調整個性的可變展示襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Food, culture, packaging, and brands that welcome playfulness.
bestFor.zh: 飲食、文化、包裝，以及容得下玩心的品牌。

summary.en: A bold single-style display face inspired by heavy advertising type.
summary.zh: 靈感來自粗重廣告字體、只有單一字重的醒目展示字體。

bestFor.en: Short headlines, posters, and visual accents used sparingly.
bestFor.zh: 短標題、海報與少量使用的視覺重點。

summary.en: A loud urban display family designed to work horizontally and vertically.
summary.zh: 聲量鮮明、可橫排也可直排的都市風展示字體家族。

bestFor.en: Signage, posters, campaigns, and deliberately loud identity work.
bestFor.zh: 招牌、海報、活動視覺與刻意張揚的識別設計。

summary.en: A typeface designed with differentiated letterforms to improve character recognition.
summary.zh: 透過拉大字形差異，提升字元辨識度的無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Accessible reading experiences and interfaces where clarity leads.
bestFor.zh: 重視清楚辨識的無障礙閱讀體驗與介面。

summary.en: A reading-focused sans with generous spacing and multiple width options.
summary.zh: 以閱讀為核心、間距寬裕並提供多種字寬選擇的無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Education, reading tools, and layouts that prioritize fluency.
bestFor.zh: 教育、閱讀工具與優先考量閱讀流暢度的版面。

summary.en: A developer-oriented monospace with clear punctuation and optional ligatures.
summary.zh: 標點清晰、提供連字功能，為開發者設計的等寬字體。

bestFor.en: Code editors, technical documentation, and developer products.
bestFor.zh: 程式碼編輯器、技術文件與開發者產品。

summary.en: A distinctive monospaced family with geometric forms and editorial energy.
summary.zh: 具有幾何字形與編輯張力、辨識度鮮明的等寬字體家族。

bestFor.en: Creative technology brands, labels, and expressive metadata.
bestFor.zh: 創意科技品牌、標籤與帶有個性的中繼資料。

summary.en: A comprehensive Traditional Chinese sans designed to pair across the Noto family.
summary.zh: 字集完整、能與 Noto 家族跨語系搭配的繁體中文無襯線字體。

bestFor.en: Traditional Chinese interfaces, localization, and dependable body text.
bestFor.zh: 繁體中文介面、多語系在地化與穩定耐讀的內文。

summary.en: A full Traditional Chinese serif family with a composed editorial voice.
summary.zh: 字集完整、帶有沉穩編輯語氣的繁體中文襯線字體家族。

bestFor.en: Traditional Chinese publishing, essays, and cultural storytelling.
bestFor.zh: 繁體中文出版、散文與文化敘事。

summary.en: Low-level accessible components for building custom React design systems.
summary.zh: 用來打造自訂 React 設計系統的底層無障礙元件。

bestFor.en: Teams that want behavior and accessibility without prescribed styling.
bestFor.zh: 需要完整互動與無障礙基礎、但想自行掌握樣式的團隊。

summary.en: Composable component source code you copy into and adapt within your project.
summary.zh: 把元件原始碼直接帶進專案，再依需求組合與調整的工具集。

bestFor.en: Product teams that value ownership, speed, and Tailwind-based customization.
bestFor.zh: 重視原始碼掌控、開發速度與 Tailwind 客製化的產品團隊。

summary.en: Unstyled accessible UI components designed to integrate with utility-first CSS.
summary.zh: 能與工具類 CSS 整合、未預設外觀的無障礙介面元件。

bestFor.en: React or Vue projects that need common interaction patterns quickly.
bestFor.zh: 需要快速導入常見互動模式的 React 或 Vue 專案。

summary.en: Accessible React components with robust interaction behavior and flexible styling.
summary.zh: 互動行為完整、樣式彈性高的無障礙 React 元件。

bestFor.en: Complex product UI where keyboard and screen-reader behavior must be reliable.
bestFor.zh: 鍵盤與螢幕閱讀器行為必須可靠的複雜產品介面。

summary.en: Headless components built from state machines for several frontend frameworks.
summary.zh: 以狀態機為基礎、支援多種前端框架的無樣式元件。

bestFor.en: Design systems that need consistent behavior across framework choices.
bestFor.zh: 需要在不同框架間維持一致互動行為的設計系統。

summary.en: Unstyled React components focused on accessibility, composability, and control.
summary.zh: 聚焦無障礙、可組合性與掌控度的無樣式 React 元件。

bestFor.en: Custom React interfaces that need primitives without a visual theme.
bestFor.zh: 需要底層元件、但不想被視覺主題綁住的 React 介面。

summary.en: A production animation library for JavaScript, React, and Vue interfaces.
summary.zh: 適用於 JavaScript、React 與 Vue 介面的產品級動畫函式庫。

bestFor.en: Interaction feedback, layout transitions, gestures, and scroll effects.
bestFor.zh: 互動回饋、版面轉場、手勢與捲動效果。

summary.en: A mature animation platform for precise timelines and complex web motion.
summary.zh: 適合精準時間軸與複雜網頁動態效果的成熟動畫平台。

bestFor.en: Campaign sites, storytelling, SVG animation, and sequenced motion.
bestFor.zh: 活動網站、敘事體驗、SVG 動畫與序列式動態效果。

summary.en: A consistent open-source icon set with lightweight SVGs and framework packages.
summary.zh: 風格一致、提供輕量 SVG 與各框架套件的開源圖示集。

bestFor.en: Product interfaces that need a broad, restrained icon vocabulary.
bestFor.zh: 需要完整且克制圖示語彙的產品介面。

summary.en: A community-driven collection of accessibility guidance, checklists, and patterns.
summary.zh: 由社群共同維護的無障礙指南、檢查清單與實作模式。

bestFor.en: Practical accessibility reviews and building team-wide fundamentals.
bestFor.zh: 實際進行無障礙檢查，以及建立團隊共同基礎。

summary.en: A concise visual reference connecting psychology principles to interface design.
summary.zh: 把心理學原則與介面設計連結起來的精簡視覺參考。

bestFor.en: Design critique, decision framing, and explaining interaction choices.
bestFor.zh: 設計評圖、決策框架，以及說明互動設計選擇。
